classification.difficultyReason: For each missing spreadsheet cell identify whether forward multiplication, reverse division or signed change/original is required, then apply money or percentage rounding. Choice among familiar taught formulas and table interpretation raises demand beyond one repeated procedure.

inlines.text: Mr Brown has a spreadsheet showing the value at which he bought his various parcels of shares, the value at 31 December last year, and the percentage increase or decrease in their value. (Decreases are shown with a negative sign.) Unfortunately, a virus has corrupted one entry in each row of his spreadsheet. Help him by calculating the missing values, correct to the nearest cent, and the missing percentages, correct to 2 decimal places.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Percentage increase}&=\frac{14321.57-98356.68}{98356.68}\times100\%\\\text{Percentage increase}&\approx-85.44\%\end{align*}$$
The negative sign indicates a decrease.
